'''M-V09''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]] it was stationed on the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Ziost Shadow]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
M-V09 appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the "Explosive Conflict" operation and begins one-time opening and closing cutscenes for the Imperial faction.<ref name="SWTOR" />
